## Packages

- `*-chrome.zip`: the Chrome package, also submitted to the Chrome Web Store.
- `*-firefox.zip`: the Firefox package, for Firefox 153 or newer, also
  submitted to addons.mozilla.org. [The Firefox guide](https://github.com/bee-san/hachidori/blob/main/docs/firefox.md)
  says how to install the ZIP itself.
- `*-source.zip` and `*-SHA256SUMS.txt`: the matching complete source and the
  checksums of every package above.
